statusHelp.implemented_and_verified: Works end to end and is covered by automated tests against the real engine.
statusHelp.external_integration_required: Needs an external service or solver that is not bundled. Nothing is simulated in its place.

features.feature: Server-side OCCT B-rep kernel in isolated worker processes
features.evidence: Kernel pool tests: crash containment, timeout kill + recovery, structured errors, deterministic recompute.
features.limits: Geometry is computed on the server; the browser receives tessellations. No offline modelling.

features.feature: Parametric feature history with dependency graph, rollback and suppression
features.evidence: Forward-reference and parameter-cycle detection; downstream-only recompute; rollback/suppression tests.

features.feature: Extrude, revolve, hole (simple/counterbore/countersink), fillet, chamfer, shell, booleans, patterns, mirror, primitives
features.evidence: Kernel tests check volumes against closed-form values, validity and persistent face names.

features.feature: Sweep and loft
features.evidence: Roundtrip test sweeps a profile along a sketch path and lofts two sections.
features.limits: Single path wire, no guide curves, twist or tangency control.

features.feature: Persistent topological naming (history-based face names, edge = face pair + hint)
features.evidence: Fillet reference survives upstream dimension changes; unresolvable references produce a re-select error.
features.limits: Faces split by later booleans can become ambiguous; the UI flags unstable names.

features.feature: 2D constraint solver (22 constraint types, DOF, redundancy and conflict isolation)
features.evidence: Solver tests: fully/under/over-constrained, conflicts isolated, drag moves only free geometry.

features.feature: Profile detection (regions, holes, islands, shared edges, open/crossing detection)
features.evidence: Profile tests including arc slots and nested islands.

features.feature: Interactive sketch editor (lines, rectangles, circles, arcs, points, splines, constraints, dimensions)
features.evidence: Uses the server solver for every edit; status, DOF and conflicts shown live.
features.limits: No trim/extend/offset tools yet; ellipse drawing is API-only.

features.feature: STEP AP214, IGES, BREP export with re-import volume verification
features.evidence: Exports are re-read and the volume compared (rel. error < 1e-4) before download.

features.feature: STL, OBJ, glTF (GLB) mesh export
features.evidence: Roundtrip test parses written meshes.

features.feature: STEP/IGES/BREP import with healing and diagnostics
features.evidence: Import tests reject garbage and mesh formats; imported solids become editable bases.
features.limits: Imported solids carry no feature history; DXF, Parasolid and native CAD formats are not supported.

features.feature: AutoForge native document (full parametric history, checksum)
features.evidence: Native export/import round trip with SHA-256 check.

features.feature: Mates (fixed, coincident, concentric, parallel, perpendicular, distance, angle, revolute, slider) with DOF reporting
features.evidence: Revolute leaves one DOF; conflicting and redundant mates are isolated.

features.feature: Exact B-rep interference and clearance checks
features.evidence: Common-volume interference with bounding-box prefilter; measured with BRepExtrema.

features.feature: Quasi-static kinematic sweeps with collision checks
features.evidence: Sweep test checks limits and collisions per step.
features.limits: Positions only; velocity/acceleration by finite differences; no dynamics, forces or contact.

features.feature: Exploded views and bill of materials
features.evidence: BOM mass from CAD volume × assigned density or cited catalog data; missing masses are flagged.

features.feature: Searchable catalog with provenance, licences and completeness
features.evidence: Seed data is generated from standards (ISO 15, ISO 4762, ISO 4032, ISO 7089, cell formats) with manufacturer values left blank.
features.limits: No manufacturer datasets are bundled; organisations import their own records with sources.

features.feature: Side-by-side comparison with unit normalisation
features.evidence: Missing values are reported as missing, never inferred; the tool never declares parts interchangeable.

features.feature: Linear static FEA (CalculiX, C3D10 tetrahedra via Gmsh)
features.evidence: Cantilever benchmark within 0.5 % of Timoshenko; equilibrium check on every run; mesh-convergence study.
features.limits: Linear elastic, small deformation, single body; no contact, no bolt preload.

features.feature: Steady-state thermal (CalculiX)
features.evidence: Flux and convection benchmarks match analytical temperatures exactly.

features.feature: Durable job queue with cancellation, timeouts and crash recovery
features.evidence: Queue tests cover timeout, crash, failure, cancel and stale-job recovery.

features.feature: CFD (external aerodynamics, coolant flow)
features.evidence: No CFD solver is bundled. Results are never simulated or estimated in its place.
features.limits: Requires an OpenFOAM (or similar) adapter and compute infrastructure.

features.feature: Modal, buckling, fatigue, nonlinear and transient analyses
features.evidence: Not implemented.

features.feature: Associative 2D drawings (HLR projections, auto dimensions, hole callouts, title block, revision table)
features.evidence: Drawing tests render views from the model, detect stale drawings and export PDF/DXF/SVG.

features.feature: GD&T feature control frames and datums (ISO 1101 / ASME Y14.5 rule checks)
features.evidence: Invalid frames block export; rule tests cover datum requirements and modifiers.
features.limits: Rules check structure only; they do not verify that a tolerance is functionally appropriate.

features.feature: Shaft, gear, spring, beam, thermal, battery pack, ISO 286 fits, tolerance stack, unit conversion
features.evidence: Calculator tests compare with closed-form results and ISO 286 table values.

features.feature: Requirement extraction, concept generation and validated CAD proposals
features.evidence: Schema-validated structured outputs; every claim is classified; proposals compile through the parametric builder before use.
features.limits: Default provider is a deterministic rules engine; Claude is used only when configured and the user consents per request.

features.feature: Private rooms, single-use email-bound invitations, roles, comments, presence
features.evidence: Invitation lifecycle, comment permissions and WebSocket origin/auth tests.

features.feature: Immutable revisions with optimistic concurrency, idempotent saves, diff and restore
features.evidence: Conflicts return 409 with the head revision; restores create new revisions.

features.feature: Real-time co-editing of the same feature tree
features.evidence: Concurrent edits are detected and resolved explicitly (reload, overwrite or save a copy); there is no live merge.

features.feature: Argon2id passwords, server sessions, CSRF, TOTP MFA, rate limits, IDOR-safe authorisation, audit log
features.evidence: Auth, CSRF, MFA, rate-limit and cross-project access tests.

features.feature: Malware scanning of uploads
features.evidence: Uploads are type-checked and content-sniffed; files are marked “not scanned” until a ClamAV integration is configured.

features.feature: Postgres persistence, S3-compatible storage, Redis events, Prometheus metrics, health/readiness
features.evidence: Restart-survival, readiness and metrics tests.

features.feature: Container images and docker compose deployment (Caddy TLS, Postgres, Redis, S3-compatible storage, SMTP)
features.evidence: The Playwright acceptance suite passes against the production-mode compose stack; the backend suite passes inside the API image against Postgres and Redis containers.
features.limits: Single-host topology; horizontal scaling of API and workers is supported by design but not load-tested.

features.feature: Backup and restore (Postgres dump + checksummed object archive + integrity verification)
features.evidence: Drill: back up, destroy all volumes, restore into a fresh stack; state fingerprint identical, integrity check and a fresh verified export pass.

features.feature: Railway deployment (one-file Infrastructure as Code: Postgres, Redis, Storage Bucket, API, worker, web)
features.evidence: The project file typechecks against the Railway SDK and compiles to the intended resources; the Playwright suite (including the realtime WebSocket) passes in a local Railway-like topology where only the web service is exposed.
features.limits: Not yet applied on a live Railway project; virtual-hosted bucket addressing and IPv6 private networking are exercised only by unit tests here. Outbound SMTP is blocked on Railway's Hobby plan, so email needs a Resend key.
